question: Where do FNaF 3's camera monitor, audio lure and vent seal live on the handset, and what does reaching them cost?
contactRule: 160 ms HELD contact. `adb shell input tap` is a near-instantaneous contact and this engine drops it phase-dependently -- it worked 3 times, then failed 3 consecutive runs with the menu rows provably unmoved. A 160 ms held contact has landed on every attempt since. This is the project's own MIN_CONTACT_MS (Night 5) transferring intact to a second game, and it should be assumed for every game here.

panRule.mechanism: Panning is a HOLD, not a swipe. Two swipes moved 208 px; one ~2.5 s hold at (2200,540) moves 968 px and saturates at the world edge. Three further holds produced byte-identical frames.
panRule.crossCheck: 968 px measured on device against 976 px predicted by the frame header (2000 px world in a 1024 px window). Two independent methods agree to within 8 px.
panRule.startState: Every game starts the night panned fully left. FNaF 3's single right hold saturates at 968 px; FNaF 1's left hold moved 0 px. Pan at t=0 is therefore a known constant, not something to observe.

cameraMonitor.requires: panned-right view; DOES NOT EXIST at pan 0

findings: The camera control is not on screen at rest: the office view must be panned right before it exists to tap. The office is 2000x768 in a 1024 window and the extracted cam objects sit at world x 1640-1940, the right quarter. So the camera monitor HAS NO FIXED SCREEN COORDINATE AT ALL, and no calibration taken at rest can ever produce one.
Map Toggle swaps the camera map for the VENT map, showing CAM 11-15 joined by link lines -- the same five vents, in the same numbering, the event sheet gave.
Sealing a vent is a DOUBLE-TAP on its vent cam button, stated by the game's own on-screen instruction. Not a single contact.

Play Audio is ABSENT in vent-map mode. The lure and the seal live in mutually exclusive view states, so a route cannot do both without paying a toggle between them. That is a scheduling constraint, not a UI detail, and it interacts directly with the lure's move-counter reset.
ruledOut: The bottom-centre tab with a downward chevron and TAP is the MAINTENANCE PANEL, not the monitor: tapping at (880,1020) and at (1219,1021) both open maintenance. Two ends of one bar.
A slim white vertical bar at the right edge (x ~2368-2378, y ~390-680) is a glitched Android system marker, not a game control. Tapping near it risks an edge gesture rather than anything in the game.
consequence: device-profile-v1's flat controlMap cannot express any of these controls even in principle: it carries one screen coordinate per control and no view offset. Closing that is plans/26 blocker 1.
notMeasured: The minimum pan hold duration below 2500 ms.
Whether these coordinates hold at any Controller Size other than the 120% measured in fnaf3-title-gate-negatives-20260920.

frames.note: Game frames are never committed (docs/evidence/README.md publishing boundary). This record is the derived reading.

rung: None. plans/26 states that nothing in it is a claim or a Plan 12 rung.
